_comment: Contract §5 — resolved values through BOTH surfaces (character API and the char-var node arms; engines additionally route the same reads through the data-asset bridge branch, which must agree by construction). Every case ref that carries characterId ALSO carries a DECOY path naming the other character: id wins, always. expected.stored, where present, is the characters.json byte form (string-table key / asset id) — a byte promise; expected.value is the resolved form. GENERATED by src/__tests__/runtime/character-contract-fixtures.test.ts (inputs: the real JSON export; expectations: the HTML runtime) — do not hand-edit; regenerate with REGEN_FIXTURES=1 and re-copy into the three plugin repos.

cases.description: Own boolean declaration; the path sibling names the villain, whose Alive is false.
Integer declared on the ARCHETYPE, overridden on hero (250) — the flatten bakes the override; the villain's Coins is 66.
Float inherited from the archetype UNTOUCHED (1.25); the villain declares its own Stride 3.5.
String inherited from the archetype; the villain declares NO Honor at all, so a path-first engine reads a miss where a value belongs.
cases.scope: §9 entry 6 (A5): assert `value` on surfaces that own language state, `stored` on surfaces that answer the stored key verbatim; the save and export lanes ALWAYS write the stored key.
